nodes.description: IBridge token that is staked and distributed by the reward pools
Mapping tokenAddress => RewardPool holding pool configuration, staking totals and accumulated rewards per share
Mapping tokenAddress => staker => StakerInfo holding balance, stakeUpdateTime, rewardDebt and pool token address
IBuyBackAndBurn contract that receives rewards of pools without stakers for burning
Default withdrawal fee in ppm applied when unstaking
Per-token withdrawal fee overrides in ppm used by unstake
Initializer that wires the bridge token, buy-back contract, default fee and admin roles
Role-gated setter for the default reward pool withdrawal fee
Role-gated setter for the per-token reward pool withdrawal fee
Role-gated setter for the minimum stake amount of a reward pool
Role-gated setter for the maximum stake amount of a reward pool
Role-gated setter for the maximum pool size of a reward pool
Role-gated setter that replaces the buy-back contract and re-approves the bridge token
Stakes bridge tokens, harvests pending rewards and mints interest bearing tokens to the caller
Harvests rewards, deducts the withdrawal fee, burns the fee and returns bridge tokens to the caller
Hook called by PoolsInterestBearingToken on transfer to keep stakes and rewards up to date
Public function that accrues pending rewards into accRewardPerShare and updates lastRewardAmount
Creates pools if needed and funds them, forwarding rewards to buy-back when no stakers exist
External entry point that distributes unharvested staking rewards for a staker
Private reward distribution routine that computes accumulated rewards and transfers them
View function returning the unharvested reward amount for a staker
msg.sender / _msgSender supplied by the caller
block.timestamp used as stake update time
_bridgeToken.safeTransferFrom pulls the staked amount from the caller
_bridgeToken.safeTransfer returns the unstaked amount to the caller
IBridge(_bridgeToken).burn burns the withdrawal fee amount
rewardToken.safeTransfer sends harvested rewards to the staker
buyBackAndBurnContract.depositERC20 external call forwarding rewards of empty pools
_bridgeToken.approve grants maximum allowance to the buy-back contract
tokenAddress argument of stake/unstake identifying the reward pool
amount argument of stake/unstake specifying tokens to stake or withdraw
fee argument of setDefaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee in ppm
sourceNetworkTokenAddress argument of setRewardPoolWithdrawalFee
stakerAddress argument of harvest/_harvest selecting the reward recipient
token argument of addRewards, the reward token being added
from argument of transferInterestBearingTokenHandler, the transfer source
to argument of transferInterestBearingTokenHandler, the transfer recipient
RewardPool storage/memory reference fetched from rewardPools in stake/unstake/handler
StakerInfo storage reference fetched from stakes in stake/unstake/harvest
rewardAmount computed in _harvest as accumulated minus rewardDebt
withdrFeeAmount computed in unstake from amount and relative fee

amount is the staked quantity consumed directly by the stake flow
fee is the only input written by the default withdrawal fee setter

stakerAddress selects the stake record that _harvest pays out to

to identifies the receiver stake credited inside the transfer handler
